sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
✨ Two-in-One Power – A first-of-its-kind bracelet that blends Obsidian (protection) with Pyrite (prosperity).

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Pyrite → The “Money Magnet Crystal,” it attracts abundance, prosperity, and financial growth.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Obsidian → Known as the “Protection Stone,” it deflects negativity, shields aura & guards from envy.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Together, they create the perfect balance of protection + prosperity.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear it daily

Put the bracelet on your wrist in the morning and keep it with you through work, travel, or regular activities.
• Best Day to Wear

Wear the Richie Rich Dual Bead Bracelet on Thursday morning when your intention is growth, money energy, and success.
• Let both beads do their role

Pyrite supports action and drive, while Black Obsidian helps you stay grounded—no need to adjust or overthink placement.
• Use it during focused tasks

Wear it during meetings, work sessions, or important decisions when you need clarity and stability.
• Stay consistent

Regular wear helps it naturally become part of your routine and mindset.
• Store it properly

When not in use, keep it in a clean, dry place to maintain its quality.
• Simple care

Wipe gently with a soft cloth and avoid water or harsh chemicals.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 There’s a certain phase in life where you stop chasing everything—and start choosing what actually matters. Growth, focus, and peace. Not separately. Together.

That’s the thinking behind the Richie Rich Dual Bead Bracelet 🧿

Instead of mixing everything randomly, this bracelet keeps it structured. Two stones. Two roles. One purpose.

Pyrite represents drive—the part of you that wants to move forward, take action, and stay consistent. Black Obsidian represents control—the part that keeps you grounded, filters out distractions, and protects your focus.

You don’t always need more. You just need the right combination.

The bracelet reflects that idea with a clean dual-bead pattern. It’s balanced, minimal, and easy to wear daily. Whether you’re working, building something, or just trying to stay steady, it fits into your routine without extra effort.

No rituals. No overthinking. Just wear it and move ahead.

Why You’ll Love It 😍

-> India’s Most-Loved Crystal Bracelet Combo

-> Crafted by The Pyrite Man of India
-> Made with Authentic, Tested Crystals

-> Combines Power of Protection (Obsidian) & Prosperity (Pyrite)

Made using 100% true crystals, ensuring the bracelet carries unique textures, natural variations, and authentic quality, supported by a rigorous multi-step quality testing process.

A bracelet that helps you move forward while staying grounded at the same time—from India's Biggest Crystal Home Decor Brand 💙

Kindly note that images are just a graphical representation of crystals. Size, Shape and Colour may vary at the time of delivery.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Is it made from real crystals?

Yes, each bracelet is handcrafted using authentic, lab-tested Obsidian and Pyrite crystals.

2. Who can wear the Riche Rich Bracelet?

It can be worn by anyone seeking protection, luck, and prosperity — suitable for both men and women.

3. On which hand should I wear it?

Wear on your left hand to absorb positive energy and block negativity.

4. Can I wear it daily?

Absolutely! The bracelet is designed for everyday use and pairs well with any outfit.

5. How do I cleanse my bracelet?

You can cleanse it using selenite crystal recharging plate or keep it under moonlight.
